jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.description:
Posting Details

I. DEPARTMENT INFORMATION

Job Description Summary:

The Antibiotic Resistance Action Center ( ARAC ) at the George Washington University Milken Institute School of Public Health is seeking a collaborative, highly motivated, and scientifically rigorous Research Associate to join the Molecular Epidemiology and Microbiome research group. Led by Drs. Cindy Liu and Lance Price, our group investigates the impact of environmental and occupational exposures on human health within a dedicated One Health framework. Our research program is specifically focused on characterizing nasal, urogenital, and gut microbiome commensals, with the goal of leveraging commensal microbial communities to develop evidence-based strategies that prevent and treat diverse infectious and inflammatory conditions.

To achieve this, our group operates through a robust process by integrating hypothesis generation from observational, cohort-based studies with downstream mechanistic studies in advanced in vitro models, and further translating those findings into public health applications, including live biotherapeutic and point-of-care diagnostic development.

To support this dynamic process, we are seeking a Research Associate to conduct cutting-edge research who can thrive within a fast-paced, advanced multidisciplinary setting. This position offers a unique opportunity to own a diverse and exciting portfolio of research projects within a highly collaborative team, while actively engaging with, mentoring, and guiding passionate undergraduate and graduate students.

Additional Responsibilities Include: Research, Data Management, and Analysis

Methodology Development, Optimization, & Validation: Lead the development, optimization, and validation of research protocols for assigned research projects, including targeted literature searches, performing rigorous troubleshooting of failing assays, and contributing directly to follow-up experimental design.
R&D Translation to Scale-Up Implementation: Manage the lifecycle of assigned research projects, successfully progressing workflows from the initial method development and benchtop R&D stages through to large-scale, high-throughput validation and implementation studies.
Data Analysis: Independently process, analyze, and interpret experimental datasets, including the use of appropriate analytic (statistical/epidemiological) methods required to evaluate experimental outcomes, determine statistical significance, and prepare publication-quality tables and figures.
Sample, Data, and Workflow Management: Oversee sample tracking, processing workflows, and comprehensive lab and data analysis management for large-scale studies containing clinical and environmental sample and metadata collections designed for multi-omic, culture-based, and in vitro studies.

Manuscript & Grant Preparation

Contribute directly to writing, critically reviewing, and formatting drafts for manuscripts and grant applications, in collaboration with the PIs and other research team members. Present findings professionally at academic or scientific conferences

Laboratory Operations:

Day-to-Day Laboratory Functions: Assist with day-to-day laboratory functions, including inventory control, bio- and chemical safety compliance, and equipment maintenance, and provide technical mentorship to undergraduate and graduate ( MPH ) research trainees in collaboration with the PIs and other research team members.
Regulatory Coordination: Coordinate laboratory compliance functions, including biosafety protocols, CDC permit applications, sample transfer documentation, and sample shipping in collaboration with the PIs and other research team members.

The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

Minimum Qualifications:

Qualified candidates will hold a master’s degree and 1 year of experience in a related discipline. Degree must be conferred by the start date of the position.

Additional Required Licenses/Certifications/Posting Specific Minimum Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:

Core Competency & Adaptability: A proven track record as an independent contributor in at least two of the Core Methodology Areas listed below is preferred, paired with the necessary background knowledge, drive, and technical agility to expand into the remaining fields, is desired.
Molecular, Multi-Omics, & High-Throughput Workflows: Direct experience in the development, independent optimization, and validation of custom molecular assays (such as PCR /qPCR), sample preparation for multi-omics (metagenomics/transcriptomics, bulk or single-cell), and high-throughput workflows utilizing liquid-handling robotics is a plus. This area forms the descriptive foundation of our cohort and intervention studies.
Commensal Bacteriology & Live Biotherapeutic Formulation: Mastery of developing, optimizing, and validating bacterial culturing protocols for both aerobic and anaerobic organisms, including the isolation, selection, and physiological phenotyping of diverse commensal species using clinical specimens, is preferred. Direct experience working with lyoprotectant optimization and formulation testing for live biotherapeutics is a plus and considered a significant asset to support both observational and translational research studies.
Primary Epithelial Cell Culture & Host-Microbe/Microbe-Microbe Interactions: Hands-on expertise in using primary epithelial cell models to study host-microbe and microbe-microbe interactions, including downstream phenotypic and physiological characterization, including immunohistochemistry ( IHC ), confocal and fluorescence microscopy, and barrier function assays to assess commensal function is desired.
Immunoassays & Point-of-Care Testing ( POCT ): Direct experience in the configuration, development, optimization, and validation of immunoassays (such as ELISA ) and the evaluation or implementation of point-of-care diagnostic testing modalities to translate laboratory discoveries into scalable, translational public health solutions is preferred.
Peer-Reviewed Publication Record: A documented history of scientific contribution, evidenced by a record of peer-reviewed publications (as a first author or co-author), is a plus.
Conference Presentations: Experience preparing and delivering presentations at professional academic or scientific conferences is preferred.
Education & Experience: A master’s degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Microbiology, or a related scientific field, with dedicated research experience, is desired.
Advanced Epidemiological & Statistical Analysis: Proficiency or advanced training in applying complex epidemiological methods, linear/non-linear modeling, or multivariate survival analyses to complex patient cohorts and experimental data is a plus.
Bioinformatics Skills: Direct experience performing computational data analysis using custom bioinformatics pipelines for microbiome sequencing, genomic characterization, or multi-omic datasets using statistical software (e.g., R, Python) is preferred.
Translational & Regulatory Knowledge: Experience or a structural understanding of translational pipelines, including CMC compliance, Investigational New Drug ( IND ) related documentation, or participation in supporting clinical trial studies is desired.
Project Portfolio Management: Demonstrated capability to operate effectively as an individual contributor who can multitask, manage time efficiently across distinct studies, and make technical decisions under limited supervision is a plus.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

Docusign's Product Data Science team is looking for a Data Scientist Intern to support the development of key data products and capabilities to enable data-driven product development and decision making. In this role, you would be part of the Product Data Science team and work directly in partnership with a variety of stakeholders including but not limited to Product, Engineering and User Experience partners to support and empower them with data-driven actionable insights. You will be embedded in specific product spaces requiring you to establish and grow relationships. As a Data Scientist Intern, you'll dig into the data to uncover insights, identify opportunities for product improvements and new product development, define product metrics with goals, design experiments and develop data science models to drive customer experience, engagement, and adoption of Docusign's products.

This is an internship role for 3 months of duration.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Product Data Science.

Responsibility

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to research, build and improve data analysis to identify opportunities for product improvements, new product features, product utilization, and improve customer experience, engagement, and retention
Partner closely with the product managers, user researchers, engineers, and leadership to capture and prioritize potential insights, analysis, and data product opportunities that will drive maximum business impact
Leverage data to develop actionable analytical insights and present findings to senior management
Partner with Product teams to design, administer, and analyze the results of A/B and multivariate tests and other ML models
Design and build dashboards to provide actionable insights and key business metrics
Design, build and test reliable data pipelines to extract and transform data
Identify, design, and implement process improvements by automating manual processes for greater efficiency
Collaborate with stakeholders across organizations to support their data needs
Implement data quality checks to maintain the high quality of data
Optimize and maintain the existing pipelines
Document the work in confluence and Alation

Hybrid:
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Graduating in December 2027 and May/June 2028
English language proficiency: native or fluent
Experience with SQL for data analysis and data validation
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power Bl, or similar
Experience with statistics and rigorous analytical techniques
Experience in extracting, transforming and loading data using any data platform
Hands-on experience solving real business problems using data and analytics
Experience in working with cross-functional teams
Experience delivering on multiple competing priorities

Experience with Python or R
Familiarity with data engineering processes

jobs.title: Data Science Leader, B2B Marketing & Demand Generation
jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Data Science Leader, B2B Marketing & Demand Generation, you will partner with our B2B Marketing organization and help accelerate how businesses discover, adopt, and grow with AI.

You will be a strategic partner to our B2B Marketing leadership team, bringing a deep understanding of the B2B landscape and a point of view on how to grow a business. You will help shape our marketing strategy, identify our biggest growth opportunities, and build the data, measurement, and intelligence capabilities needed to turn those opportunities into impact.

The opportunity spans the full customer journey, from building awareness and engaging buying groups to generating demand, partnering with Sales, and helping customers adopt and expand their use of OpenAI. You will build and lead a team of data scientists and work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

We’re looking for people who bring strong B2B marketing expertise, a track record of influencing growth strategy through Data Science, and experience building and developing high-performing teams.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

Be a strategic partner to B2B Marketing leadership. Bring insights, recommendations, and a clear point of view to the most important business decisions. Help leaders understand where we are winning, where we have opportunities, and where to focus next.
Shape our growth strategy. Identify the audiences, accounts, industries, and customer journeys where we can have the greatest impact. Connect market opportunity and customer signals to marketing and go-to-market priorities.
Build a full-funnel view of the business. Connect awareness, engagement, demand, pipeline, conversion, adoption, and expansion. Make it easier for teams to understand how customers move through the journey and where we can improve their experience.
Measure what matters. Build a thoughtful approach to measuring brand and demand generation, combining experiments, causal inference, marketing mix modeling, and other methods. Help leaders understand both near-term outcomes and longer-term effects, with clarity on uncertainty and tradeoffs.
Develop buying-group and account intelligence. Bring together customer and account signals to understand who is engaging, where buying groups are developing momentum, and how Marketing and Sales can better reach and serve them.
Improve the path from self-serve to enterprise adoption. Partner across Marketing, Sales, and Product to understand when businesses are ready for a deeper relationship and how to support the transition to broader deployment and sustained usage.
Build AI-native intelligence capabilities. Partner with Engineering and product teams to turn insights into scalable tools, recommendations, and workflows that help marketers and go-to-market teams make better decisions.
Build and develop a high-performing team. Recruit and grow exceptional talent, set a high bar for analytical rigor and business impact, and create an environment where people can do their best work.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have experience leading Data Science, Analytics, or a related team in a B2B business, with a track record of influencing growth strategy and business decisions.
Have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and go-to-market, including demand generation, account-based marketing, enterprise sales cycles, and complex buying groups.
Have experience measuring marketing effectiveness using experimentation, causal inference, and other approaches, and the judgment to choose the right method for the question.
Have experience connecting marketing, sales, product, and customer data to understand the full customer journey.
Have a track record of building strong partnerships with senior leaders, challenging assumptions constructively, and turning complex analysis into clear recommendations.
Have experience hiring and developing high-performing teams, including leaders and senior individual contributors.
Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, moving between strategy and execution, and building capabilities where the path is not yet defined.

We’d Be Especially Excited If You Bring

Experience building predictive models, account intelligence, or recommendation systems that have been adopted by business teams.
Experience with product-led growth or self-serve-to-sales motions alongside enterprise go-to-market.
Curiosity about AI and a desire to use it to rethink how marketing and go-to-market teams operate.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we work to weave diversity, equity, and inclusion into our work and foster a sense of belonging throughout the company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe electricity powers modern life. As part of our Power sector, you’ll help shape how electricity is generated, transmitted and delivered as global energy demands grow. From massive data centers to modernizing transmission systems, our industry-recognized engineers and scientists have been at the forefront of grid transformation for more than a century. You’ll work side-by-side with these experts and contribute to reliable, resilient and sustainable power systems, helping communities thrive and industries expand. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive infrastructure forward, power innovation and leave your mark on our energy future.

HDR is looking for Professional Engineers for various disciplines and in multiple locations across the country to join our thriving and growing Hydropower Practice. HDR is a hydropower and dam safety industry leader. We are expert FERC Part 12 Dam Safety Program practitioners, and we are at the forefront of performing FERC Comprehensive Assessments (CAs) and Periodic Inspections (PIs). Specifically, HDR seeks Subject Matter Experts in Civil, Hydraulics/Hydrology, Structural, Geotechnical, Geological, and Mechanical engineering.

Our national Hydropower Practice engineering and regulatory team offers core services such as mechanical, electrical, structural, geotechnical and site civil engineering expertise in addition to environmental scientists and regulatory specialists. Hydropower generation is recognized as a critical and renewable component of the US energy portfolio, and our team provides engineering consulting services to all types of hydropower owners located across the U.S. and Canada. If you are looking for a vibrant work environment with career growth opportunities and the chance to work on innovative hydropower, pumped-storage and dam safety projects, we welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Hybrid or flexible work locations are available across the country. Primary duties of the Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert
include:

Support inspections and engineering assessments of existing dams and water retaining structures.
Conduct analyses, evaluations and designs; develop design options or recommendations with supporting calculations.
Preparation of contract documents including drawings, specifications, design documentation and criteria, and cost estimates including critical reports for various new and/or rehabilitation of hydraulic structures, including dams, spillways, gates, outlet works, diversion structures, retaining walls, floodwalls, water conveyance structures, foundations, etc.
Perform engineering assignments that may require critical thinking and creativity to address unique elements that have limited or no specific code based guidance.
Work with multi-disciplinary teams on a variety of hydropower, pumped storage and dam safety engineering projects.
Work independently as project engineer and provide oversight, checking, QA/QC and mentorship of staff as needed or if required.
Participate in risk assessments for dams and hydraulic structures.
Some travel is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Geological, or Geotechnical engineering (or related engineering degree).
Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in one of the following disciplines: Geotechnical, Geological, Civil/Structural or Hydrology and Hydraulics, or Mechanical engineering or life safety and economic consequence estimation.
Experience with dams, water conveyances or other constructed project works and infrastructure associated with hydropower and pumped-storage projects regulated by FERC or other agencies.
Experience working in a multi-discipline environment. 
Proficient with Microsoft Office, Excel and Word, AutoCAD and/or MicroStation experience.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Self-motivated, able to work independently and with a project team to completion of task.
An attitude and commitment to quality, teaming, innovative problem solving, communication, relationship management, and the culture that is integral to our employee ownership model.
Ability to travel as needed for inspections, meetings or other requirements.

Experience specific to the hydropower industry. This could include one or more of the following:
Experience with the FERC dam safety regulatory process including preparation of DSSMPs, DSSMRs, STIDs, and participation in Part 12D dam safety inspections.
FERC dam safety assessment, analysis, and design experience.
Hydropower design experience relative to dams, penstocks, intakes, powerhouses, and/or retaining structures in and around hydropower facilities.
FERC SQRA facilitation training and experience.

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. What if your native German fluency and the email and documents you already use every day could help shape how AI tools work for German speakers worldwide?

A native speaker of German, with natural fluency and a strong sense of register, tone, and style.

Shape AI in German. Help make AI features genuinely work for native German speakers everywhere.
Fit it around your life. Just 2–4 hours a week, from your own browser.

The Bioinformatics Programmer will develop, validate, and maintain predictive machine learning workflows for cancer research. The successful candidate will architect advanced, high-throughput computational frameworks focusing on structural informatics, foundational deep learning architectures, advanced latent variable extraction, and integrative analyses across highly complex multi-omic, molecular, and clinical datasets, with emphasis on reproducible research, translational impact, and high-quality software development. At least 5 years of directly relevant experience in cancer research, including software engineering, scientific computing, bioinformatics, or computational modeling.
Thorough knowledge of bioinformatics methods, applications programming, web development and data structures.

Strong proficiency in Python and/or R.

Proven capacity to engineer distributed computational pipelines and deploy highly optimized multi-omic algorithms for large-scale data ingestion and analysis.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver reliable results.

Deep functional experience leveraging advanced artificial intelligence modalities, expansive language architectures, and advanced latent-variable extraction techniques to cancer or biomedical data.

The Department of Urologic Surgery is a multidisciplinary clinical and research department dedicated to the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disorders of the urinary tract and male reproductive system. As part of an academic health system, the department plays a central role in training the next generation of urologists and maintains active involvement in medical student education. The department is also deeply committed to basic, translational, and clinical research, with investigators leading studies on cancer biology, novel therapeutics, surgical outcomes, health disparities, and quality improvement. Through its combined missions of patient care, education, and research, the Department of Urologic Surgery strives to advance the field, improve patient quality of life, and train future leaders in urologic health.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US:
Scripps Research is a nonprofit biomedical institute ranked as one of the most influential in the world for its impact on innovation. We celebrated our 100-year legacy in 2024. This significant milestone marks a century of seminal discoveries in immunology, infectious diseases (such as COVID-19, flu, HIV), neuroscience, heart disease, cancer, and more. Located in La Jolla, California, the institute houses six research departments, multiple Nobel laureates, a top-ranked graduate school and a leading postdoctoral training program. Scripps Research encompasses two elite and highly innovative institutes, the Calibr-Skaggs Institute for Innovative Medicines and Scripps Research Translational Institute, which merge foundational studies in biology, chemistry and computer science with translational science to produce pioneering drugs and advances in digital and precision medicine. Together, we cultivate new scientific leaders and expand the frontiers of knowledge to deliver medical breakthroughs impacting human health around the globe. If you have a passion for making a difference, this could be your opportunity to join our transformative team.

POSITION TITLE:
Research Assistant III

Position Summary

The Zwick Laboratory in the Department of Immunology & Microbiology at Scripps Research is seeking a motivated and highly organized Research Assistant (RA II or RA III, depending on experience)
to join our team studying antibody responses and developing next-generation vaccines and biologic therapies.

Our research focuses on HIV vaccine design, broadly neutralizing antibodies, HIV envelope (Env), and germline-targeting immunogens
, with opportunities to extend these approaches to other viral pathogens and antibody-based therapies. Current studies combine molecular and cellular immunology, virology, antibody biology, flow cytometry, next-generation sequencing, and structure-guided vaccine design, including vaccine studies in mouse and nonhuman-primate models.

We are especially interested in someone who enjoys hands-on experimental work, wants to understand the scientific questions behind the experiments, and can grow into increasing responsibility within the laboratory.

In this position you will plan and conduct complex or novel research projects that involve the performance of non-routine procedures, development of new or improved techniques and evaluation criteria, thorough data analysis and complex interpretations of results; assist in designing experiments; operate sophisticated scientific lab equipment; may plan and conduct a small or average size project or a large portion of a more diverse project; may supervise or provide work direction and training to a small staff of professional-level employees; perform other related duties, tasks and responsibilities as required or assigned.

Responsibilities And Duties

The successful candidate will contribute directly to ongoing research and, depending on experience, may:

Maintain, transfect, and characterize mammalian cell lines, including stable cell lines
Perform flow cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS), including data analysis and standardized presentation of results
Carry out PCR and prepare samples for next-generation sequencing
Perform ELISA and other antibody-binding and functional assays
Support HIV virology and antibody neutralization studies
Organize, analyze, interpret, and clearly present experimental data
Coordinate experiments with laboratory personnel, Scripps core facilities, collaborators, and external service providers
Maintain accurate experimental records, sample inventories, and laboratory workflows
Troubleshoot experiments and communicate progress, problems, and next steps promptly
As experience grows, assist with training junior personnel and day-to-day laboratory organization

Prior experience in either immunology/cell biology or molecular biology/virology
would be valuable. Candidates do not need experience in every technique; we are looking for someone who is technically capable, eager to learn, and interested in developing breadth across these areas.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree or higher in biology, immunology, microbiology, molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, or a related field.
Requires a minimum of 5 years’ experience.
Candidates possessing a master’s degree, 3+ years’ experience required.
Strong experimental organization and attention to detail
Reliability, productivity, follow-through, and effective communication
Ability to troubleshoot and manage several ongoing experimental priorities
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others
Interest in increasingly interpreting data and understanding how individual experiments contribute to the larger scientific question

We are especially interested in candidates looking for a stable position with opportunities to grow in responsibility over time
. For the right person, the position offers the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility for experimental coordination, laboratory organization, mentoring, and day-to-day research operations.

Physical Requirements

This position works in a laboratory or vivarium environment. Further details of the physical requirements of established essential functions for this position will be addressed/discussed during the interview process.

jobs.description:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

About the Role

As a member of the Protein Engineering team at Xaira, you will play a key role in the AI-driven discovery and development of protein therapeutics, helping evaluate molecules generated through integrated experimental and computational design.

As a Research Associate II, you will characterize designed antibodies and proteins to support hit characterization and lead selection and optimization. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in flow cytometry, binder analysis, and mammalian cell culture within a biotherapeutics discovery setting, coupled with a proactive and can-do attitude. This is a hands-on, lab-based, on-site position.

Responsibilities

Support the discovery and development of therapeutic molecules through hands-on laboratory work.
Plan, execute and analyze flow cytometry assays to characterize binding of monoclonal and multispecific antibodies.
Support the development, optimization and automation of flow cytometry assays.
Maintain mammalian cell lines: passage, expand, bank, cryopreserve, and thaw and prepare cells for analysis.
Characterize antibody and protein activity using reporter and other cell-based assays.
Analyze experimental data, generate reports, and present findings at team and cross-functional group meetings.
Characterize protein and antibody interactions using biosensors (BLI, SPR).
Support protein production and perform small-scale labeling as needed
Register and track antibodies, proteins, and cell lines in dedicated databases and inventory systems.
Maintain accurate, timely, and complete experimental records in an electronic laboratory notebook (ELN).
Ensure compliance with laboratory safety protocols and contribute to lab organization, instrument upkeep, and operations.

Qualifications

Required

BS in biology, immunology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related discipline with 2+ years of relevant laboratory experience, or an MS with 0+ years; industry experience preferred.
Hands-on experience in performing and analyzing flow cytometry assays, ideally cell-based binding assays for antibodies or other biologics.
Proficiency with FlowJo (or equivalent cytometry analysis software) and GraphPad Prism and/or JMP.
Experience with mammalian cell culture, including aseptic technique, cell banking, and cryopreservation.
Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail in sample handling, data analysis, and record keeping.
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to present data to the team.
Proactive, self-starter mindset; able to manage multiple experiments and work independently once trained.
Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, collaborative startup environment.

Preferred

Experience with high-throughput or plate-based flow cytometry and multicolor panel setup.
Familiarity with antibody formats (monoclonals, bispecifics, antibody fragments).
Experience with biosensor binding analysis (BLI and/or SPR).
Experience with protein biochemistry, such as affinity purification, SDS-PAGE, or antibody conjugation and labeling.
Experience with lab automation or liquid handlers.

Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, seeking to provide an open, flexible, and friendly work environment to empower employees and provide them with a platform to develop their long-term careers. A Summary of Benefits is available for all applicants. We offer a competitive package that includes base salary, bonus, and equity. The base pay range for this position is expected to be $103,000 - $126,500 annually; however, the base pay offered may vary depending on the market, job-related knowledge, skills and capabilities, and experience.

Job Description

Bioinformatics, Field Applications Scientist

Clinical Genomics & Human Genetics | Central/Mountain/Pacific Time Zones

About Us

Oxford Nanopore Technologies is transforming how scientists analyze DNA and RNA through real-time, scalable sequencing technology. Our platforms enable researchers to analyze native DNA and RNA, from short to ultra-long fragments, supporting advances in human genetics, clinical research, biopharma, and beyond. Our goal is to enable the analysis of anything, by anyone, anywhere.

About The Role

We are seeking a Bioinformatics, Field Applications Scientist with a strong background in human genomics, clinical bioinformatics, or biopharma applications, combined with experience in long-read sequencing technologies.

In this role, you will partner with our Sales team and customers to provide scientific and technical expertise across Oxford Nanopore sequencing platforms and bioinformatics software. You will help researchers design experiments, troubleshoot sequencing and analysis workflows, interpret complex genomic data, and successfully adopt our technology.

We are particularly interested in scientists with hands-on experience analyzing human genetic or clinical sequencing data, including applications in oncology, rare diseases, inherited disorders, precision medicine, or therapeutic development.

This opportunity is well suited to a technically strong bioinformatics scientist who enjoys solving problems, collaborating with researchers, and translating complex scientific concepts into practical solutions. Prior commercial experience is valued, but we also welcome candidates from clinical laboratories, biotechnology, pharmaceutical research, and translational research environments who demonstrate strong communication skills and an interest in customer-facing scientific work.

Location:
Field-based, United States. Candidates should reside in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones, particularly Colorado, Texas, and the western U.S.

Travel:
Approximately 30–40%, including customer visits and occasional overnight travel.

What You'll Do

Provide bioinformatics expertise and technical support to customers working in human genetics, clinical genomics, oncology, and biopharma research.
Support the design, implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization of next-generation and long-read sequencing analysis workflows.
Guide customers through genomic data analysis, including variant calling, structural variant detection, genome assembly, transcriptomics, and other relevant applications.
Collaborate with Sales to deliver technical consultations, product demonstrations, scientific presentations, and customer training.
Help customers transition from short-read sequencing technologies to long-read sequencing applications, where appropriate.
Troubleshoot bioinformatics pipelines, sequencing data quality, computational environments, and software-related challenges.
Translate complex scientific and computational concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for researchers and laboratory teams.
Build and maintain strong technical relationships with customers to support successful adoption of Oxford Nanopore technologies.
Partner with internal commercial, technical support, and product development teams to address customer needs and share market insights.
Document customer interactions and technical activities in the CRM.

What You'll Bring

Education: Advanced degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genetics, Genomics, Molecular Biology, or a related life sciences discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Human Genomics Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience analyzing human genomic or transcriptomic datasets, including applications in human genetics, molecular diagnostics, oncology, inherited disease, or related human biological research.
Clinical or Biopharma Bioinformatics: Practical bioinformatics experience supporting at least one of the following:
Clinical genomics, molecular pathology, or genomic diagnostic workflows.
Pharmaceutical or biotechnology research, including drug discovery, biomarker identification, or therapeutic development.
Translational research involving human disease, patient-derived samples, or clinically relevant genomic datasets.

Long-Read Sequencing: Hands-on experience with long-read sequencing technologies and associated bioinformatics analysis workflows.
NGS Data Analysis: Experience developing, implementing, or troubleshooting sequencing analysis pipelines involving one or more of the following: genomic variant calling, structural variant analysis, genome assembly, transcriptomics, or genomic annotation.
Programming and Computing: Proficiency in Python or R, experience working in UNIX/Linux environments, and familiarity with high-performance computing or cloud-based analysis environments.
Scientific Communication: Ability to explain complex bioinformatics concepts clearly to scientists and stakeholders with varying levels of computational expertise.
Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to independently investigate technical challenges, interpret data, and collaborate with scientific teams to identify solutions.
Travel: Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30–40% to support customer engagements, training, and scientific events.

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience in a Field Applications Scientist, Bioinformatics Support Scientist, Technical Applications Scientist, or other customer-facing scientific role.
Direct experience with Oxford Nanopore platforms, software, and analysis tools such as MinKNOW, Dorado, or EPI2ME.
Experience supporting clinical sequencing technologies, bioinformatics software, or genomic analysis platforms.
Familiarity with human structural variants, somatic and germline variant analysis, cancer genomics, or rare disease applications.
Experience with workflow management and reproducible analysis tools such as Nextflow, Snakemake, Docker, or similar platforms.
Experience delivering scientific presentations, technical workshops, or training to external users.
Familiarity with AWS or other cloud computing environments.

Travel & Work Style

This is a field-based position requiring regular customer engagement and travel, generally 30–40%, including occasional overnight trips. Candidates should be comfortable working independently, collaborating across teams, and supporting customers with varying scientific and computational needs.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this position is $97,479 to $121,849, depending on skills and experience. Certain roles within Oxford Nanopore Technologies are eligible for annual bonuses and stock awards based on individual performance. U.S. employees have access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, short- and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, commuter benefits, and other offerings.

Oxford Nanopore Technologies is committed to equal employment opportunity. Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and abilities to perform the duties of the job.

About Us

Oxford Nanopore Technologies: Our goal is to bring the widest benefits to society through enabling the analysis of anything, by anyone, anywhere. The company has developed a new generation of nanopore-based sensing technology for faster, information rich, accessible and affordable molecular analysis. The first application is DNA/RNA sequencing, and the technology is in development for the analysis of other types of molecules including proteins. The technology is used to understand and characterise the biology of humans and diseases such as cancer, plants, animals, bacteria, viruses, and whole environments. With a thriving culture of ambition and strong innovation goals, Oxford Nanopore is a UK headquartered company with global operations and customers in more than 125 countries.

jobs.description:
Job Description

This position is represented by SEIU Local 2007 and the collective bargaining agreement between the university and SEIU Local 2007 governs the terms and conditions of employment.

This position has been deemed critical by the School of Humanities and Sciences Dean’s Office and is exempt from the hiring freeze.

Work Arrangement:
This is an on-site only position based on the Stanford campus

Budgeted Salary:
The budgeted base salary for this position is $34.58 per hour.

The School of Humanities and Sciences (H&S)
is the foundation of a liberal arts education at Stanford. The school encompasses 24 departments and 25 interdisciplinary programs. H&S is home to fundamental and applied research, where free, open, and critical inquiry is pursued across disciplines. As the university’s largest school, H&S serves as the foundation of a Stanford undergraduate education no matter which discipline students pursue as a major. Graduate students work alongside world-renowned faculty to pursue and shape foundational research that leads to breakthroughs and discoveries that shed new light on the past, influence the present, and shape the future. Together, faculty and students in H&S engage in inspirational teaching, learning, and research every day.

Department/Program Description

The Department of Biology at Stanford University is devoted to discovering fundamental knowledge of the living world: from the behavior of single molecules to dynamics of cells, organisms, populations, and interactions of biological systems with our planet. We are dedicated to developing innovative training experiences for the next generation of biologists and to building an inclusive learning environment that unites members from diverse disciplines and life experiences. The Department is the largest in the School of Humanities and Sciences with over 100 active and emeritus faculty, lecturers and research staff, over 240 PhD and postdoc trainees and over 60 non-academic staff who advance the department’s research and teaching missions. The department serves over 220 undergraduate students who major in Biology and more than 3,600 enrollees in our courses each year. Learn more about the department at biology.stanford.edu.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Life Science Technician I (LST I) to join the Lowe Lab and help launch a new transgenic echinoderm facility. Based at Hopkins Marine Station, this LST I will rear transgenic sea urchins and sea stars from larvae through metamorphosis and maintain juveniles and adults in Tecniplast aquatic housing racks. Day-to-day work is primarily animal husbandry: rearing and feeding larvae, maintaining the phytoplankton cultures used as larval food, caring for adult sea urchin and sea star broodstock, and keeping the rack systems clean and running. Because the rearing and housing methods were developed by

collaborating labs and are new to Hopkins, the technician will play a key role in adapting and troubleshooting them. The role also includes microinjecting eggs with transgenic constructs, keeping meticulous records of animals, cultures, and transgenic lines, and providing occasional administrative support to the lab. The technician will work under the direction of the PI and senior lab members. This is a 100% FTE, bargaining unit, onsite, one-year fixed-term position with possibility of renewal.

Preferred Requirements

Additional highly preferred qualifications for this position include:

Bachelor’s degree in biology, marine biology, or a related field.
Experience with aquatic animal husbandry, such as rearing marine invertebrate larvae or maintaining seawater or recirculating aquarium systems.
Experience culturing microalgae or other live feeds.
Experience with microinjection or other fine manipulation under a microscope.
Exceptional organization and record-keeping, with close attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and comfort adapting and troubleshooting new protocols.
Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including occasional weekend and holiday animal care.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Very simple animal dissection such as removing a readily accessible organ, preparation before and assistance during surgery, administration of medication and post-surgery care.
Histological procedures involving fixation of tissue and staining specimens with stains that do not require microscopic control in proceeding from step to step.
Maintenance and transfer of established cell lines where the culture conditions are well defined.
Biochemical assays (often colorimetric or spectrophotometric) of compounds or enzymatic activity using well-established procedures where the determination of any settings or adjustments is provided to the technician.
Molecular biology assays (polymerase chain reaction, sequencing reactions) where the protocol is well established.
Operation of instruments (e.g., spectrophotometer, fraction collector, scintillation counter, PCR machines, light microscope, cell counter) where the settings are simple or prescribed; techniques such as centrifugation (not involving density gradients) or limited black and white photography.
Isolation, purification and maintenance of bacteria and basic manipulation of bacterial plasmids using well-established protocols; determination of the concentration of cells.
Complete and accurate documentation of the work performed.

Minimum Education And Experience

One year’s employment experience in laboratory work or a combination of equivalent education and relevant work experience/training (e.g., one year of college science).

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Work requires the ability to follow detailed instructions and keep accurate records.

new_jobs.description:
Posting Details

I. DEPARTMENT INFORMATION

Job Description Summary:

The Antibiotic Resistance Action Center ( ARAC ) at the George Washington University Milken Institute School of Public Health is seeking a collaborative, highly motivated, and scientifically rigorous Research Associate to join the Molecular Epidemiology and Microbiome research group. Led by Drs. Cindy Liu and Lance Price, our group investigates the impact of environmental and occupational exposures on human health within a dedicated One Health framework. Our research program is specifically focused on characterizing nasal, urogenital, and gut microbiome commensals, with the goal of leveraging commensal microbial communities to develop evidence-based strategies that prevent and treat diverse infectious and inflammatory conditions.

To achieve this, our group operates through a robust process by integrating hypothesis generation from observational, cohort-based studies with downstream mechanistic studies in advanced in vitro models, and further translating those findings into public health applications, including live biotherapeutic and point-of-care diagnostic development.

To support this dynamic process, we are seeking a Research Associate to conduct cutting-edge research who can thrive within a fast-paced, advanced multidisciplinary setting. This position offers a unique opportunity to own a diverse and exciting portfolio of research projects within a highly collaborative team, while actively engaging with, mentoring, and guiding passionate undergraduate and graduate students.

Additional Responsibilities Include: Research, Data Management, and Analysis

Methodology Development, Optimization, & Validation: Lead the development, optimization, and validation of research protocols for assigned research projects, including targeted literature searches, performing rigorous troubleshooting of failing assays, and contributing directly to follow-up experimental design.
R&D Translation to Scale-Up Implementation: Manage the lifecycle of assigned research projects, successfully progressing workflows from the initial method development and benchtop R&D stages through to large-scale, high-throughput validation and implementation studies.
Data Analysis: Independently process, analyze, and interpret experimental datasets, including the use of appropriate analytic (statistical/epidemiological) methods required to evaluate experimental outcomes, determine statistical significance, and prepare publication-quality tables and figures.
Sample, Data, and Workflow Management: Oversee sample tracking, processing workflows, and comprehensive lab and data analysis management for large-scale studies containing clinical and environmental sample and metadata collections designed for multi-omic, culture-based, and in vitro studies.

Manuscript & Grant Preparation

Contribute directly to writing, critically reviewing, and formatting drafts for manuscripts and grant applications, in collaboration with the PIs and other research team members. Present findings professionally at academic or scientific conferences

Laboratory Operations:

Day-to-Day Laboratory Functions: Assist with day-to-day laboratory functions, including inventory control, bio- and chemical safety compliance, and equipment maintenance, and provide technical mentorship to undergraduate and graduate ( MPH ) research trainees in collaboration with the PIs and other research team members.
Regulatory Coordination: Coordinate laboratory compliance functions, including biosafety protocols, CDC permit applications, sample transfer documentation, and sample shipping in collaboration with the PIs and other research team members.

The omission of specific duties does not preclude the supervisor from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

Minimum Qualifications:

Qualified candidates will hold a master’s degree and 1 year of experience in a related discipline. Degree must be conferred by the start date of the position.

Additional Required Licenses/Certifications/Posting Specific Minimum Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:

Core Competency & Adaptability: A proven track record as an independent contributor in at least two of the Core Methodology Areas listed below is preferred, paired with the necessary background knowledge, drive, and technical agility to expand into the remaining fields, is desired.
Molecular, Multi-Omics, & High-Throughput Workflows: Direct experience in the development, independent optimization, and validation of custom molecular assays (such as PCR /qPCR), sample preparation for multi-omics (metagenomics/transcriptomics, bulk or single-cell), and high-throughput workflows utilizing liquid-handling robotics is a plus. This area forms the descriptive foundation of our cohort and intervention studies.
Commensal Bacteriology & Live Biotherapeutic Formulation: Mastery of developing, optimizing, and validating bacterial culturing protocols for both aerobic and anaerobic organisms, including the isolation, selection, and physiological phenotyping of diverse commensal species using clinical specimens, is preferred. Direct experience working with lyoprotectant optimization and formulation testing for live biotherapeutics is a plus and considered a significant asset to support both observational and translational research studies.
Primary Epithelial Cell Culture & Host-Microbe/Microbe-Microbe Interactions: Hands-on expertise in using primary epithelial cell models to study host-microbe and microbe-microbe interactions, including downstream phenotypic and physiological characterization, including immunohistochemistry ( IHC ), confocal and fluorescence microscopy, and barrier function assays to assess commensal function is desired.
Immunoassays & Point-of-Care Testing ( POCT ): Direct experience in the configuration, development, optimization, and validation of immunoassays (such as ELISA ) and the evaluation or implementation of point-of-care diagnostic testing modalities to translate laboratory discoveries into scalable, translational public health solutions is preferred.
Peer-Reviewed Publication Record: A documented history of scientific contribution, evidenced by a record of peer-reviewed publications (as a first author or co-author), is a plus.
Conference Presentations: Experience preparing and delivering presentations at professional academic or scientific conferences is preferred.
Education & Experience: A master’s degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Microbiology, or a related scientific field, with dedicated research experience, is desired.
Advanced Epidemiological & Statistical Analysis: Proficiency or advanced training in applying complex epidemiological methods, linear/non-linear modeling, or multivariate survival analyses to complex patient cohorts and experimental data is a plus.
Bioinformatics Skills: Direct experience performing computational data analysis using custom bioinformatics pipelines for microbiome sequencing, genomic characterization, or multi-omic datasets using statistical software (e.g., R, Python) is preferred.
Translational & Regulatory Knowledge: Experience or a structural understanding of translational pipelines, including CMC compliance, Investigational New Drug ( IND ) related documentation, or participation in supporting clinical trial studies is desired.
Project Portfolio Management: Demonstrated capability to operate effectively as an individual contributor who can multitask, manage time efficiently across distinct studies, and make technical decisions under limited supervision is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Product Data Science Intern
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

Docusign's Product Data Science team is looking for a Data Scientist Intern to support the development of key data products and capabilities to enable data-driven product development and decision making. In this role, you would be part of the Product Data Science team and work directly in partnership with a variety of stakeholders including but not limited to Product, Engineering and User Experience partners to support and empower them with data-driven actionable insights. You will be embedded in specific product spaces requiring you to establish and grow relationships. As a Data Scientist Intern, you'll dig into the data to uncover insights, identify opportunities for product improvements and new product development, define product metrics with goals, design experiments and develop data science models to drive customer experience, engagement, and adoption of Docusign's products.

This is an internship role for 3 months of duration.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Product Data Science.

Responsibility

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to research, build and improve data analysis to identify opportunities for product improvements, new product features, product utilization, and improve customer experience, engagement, and retention
Partner closely with the product managers, user researchers, engineers, and leadership to capture and prioritize potential insights, analysis, and data product opportunities that will drive maximum business impact
Leverage data to develop actionable analytical insights and present findings to senior management
Partner with Product teams to design, administer, and analyze the results of A/B and multivariate tests and other ML models
Design and build dashboards to provide actionable insights and key business metrics
Design, build and test reliable data pipelines to extract and transform data
Identify, design, and implement process improvements by automating manual processes for greater efficiency
Collaborate with stakeholders across organizations to support their data needs
Implement data quality checks to maintain the high quality of data
Optimize and maintain the existing pipelines
Document the work in confluence and Alation

Job Designation

Hybrid:
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

Currently in the process of obtaining, a Bachelors/MS degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related engineering field
Graduating in December 2027 and May/June 2028
English language proficiency: native or fluent
Experience with SQL for data analysis and data validation
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power Bl, or similar
Experience with statistics and rigorous analytical techniques
Experience in extracting, transforming and loading data using any data platform
Hands-on experience solving real business problems using data and analytics
Experience in working with cross-functional teams
Experience delivering on multiple competing priorities
This role is not eligible for OPT or sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred

Ability to present data in a visual format and explain the insights clearly and concisely
Experience with A/B testing, cohort analysis, user segmentation, and other core product analytics methodologies
Experience designing and refining machine learning models
Experience with Python or R
Familiarity with data engineering processes
Highly motivated, organized, self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment
A strong individual contributor who partners well with internal teams

Wage Transparency

Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

California: $38 - $44/hour

Work Authorization Notice:
Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

new_jobs.title: Data Science Leader, B2B Marketing & Demand Generation
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Data Science Leader, B2B Marketing & Demand Generation, you will partner with our B2B Marketing organization and help accelerate how businesses discover, adopt, and grow with AI.

You will be a strategic partner to our B2B Marketing leadership team, bringing a deep understanding of the B2B landscape and a point of view on how to grow a business. You will help shape our marketing strategy, identify our biggest growth opportunities, and build the data, measurement, and intelligence capabilities needed to turn those opportunities into impact.

The opportunity spans the full customer journey, from building awareness and engaging buying groups to generating demand, partnering with Sales, and helping customers adopt and expand their use of OpenAI. You will build and lead a team of data scientists and work closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

We’re looking for people who bring strong B2B marketing expertise, a track record of influencing growth strategy through Data Science, and experience building and developing high-performing teams.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In This Role, You Will

Be a strategic partner to B2B Marketing leadership. Bring insights, recommendations, and a clear point of view to the most important business decisions. Help leaders understand where we are winning, where we have opportunities, and where to focus next.
Shape our growth strategy. Identify the audiences, accounts, industries, and customer journeys where we can have the greatest impact. Connect market opportunity and customer signals to marketing and go-to-market priorities.
Build a full-funnel view of the business. Connect awareness, engagement, demand, pipeline, conversion, adoption, and expansion. Make it easier for teams to understand how customers move through the journey and where we can improve their experience.
Measure what matters. Build a thoughtful approach to measuring brand and demand generation, combining experiments, causal inference, marketing mix modeling, and other methods. Help leaders understand both near-term outcomes and longer-term effects, with clarity on uncertainty and tradeoffs.
Develop buying-group and account intelligence. Bring together customer and account signals to understand who is engaging, where buying groups are developing momentum, and how Marketing and Sales can better reach and serve them.
Improve the path from self-serve to enterprise adoption. Partner across Marketing, Sales, and Product to understand when businesses are ready for a deeper relationship and how to support the transition to broader deployment and sustained usage.
Build AI-native intelligence capabilities. Partner with Engineering and product teams to turn insights into scalable tools, recommendations, and workflows that help marketers and go-to-market teams make better decisions.
Build and develop a high-performing team. Recruit and grow exceptional talent, set a high bar for analytical rigor and business impact, and create an environment where people can do their best work.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have experience leading Data Science, Analytics, or a related team in a B2B business, with a track record of influencing growth strategy and business decisions.
Have a strong understanding of B2B marketing and go-to-market, including demand generation, account-based marketing, enterprise sales cycles, and complex buying groups.
Have experience measuring marketing effectiveness using experimentation, causal inference, and other approaches, and the judgment to choose the right method for the question.
Have experience connecting marketing, sales, product, and customer data to understand the full customer journey.
Have a track record of building strong partnerships with senior leaders, challenging assumptions constructively, and turning complex analysis into clear recommendations.
Have experience hiring and developing high-performing teams, including leaders and senior individual contributors.
Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, moving between strategy and execution, and building capabilities where the path is not yet defined.

We’d Be Especially Excited If You Bring

Experience building predictive models, account intelligence, or recommendation systems that have been adopted by business teams.
Experience with product-led growth or self-serve-to-sales motions alongside enterprise go-to-market.
Curiosity about AI and a desire to use it to rethink how marketing and go-to-market teams operate.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

new_jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we work to weave diversity, equity, and inclusion into our work and foster a sense of belonging throughout the company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe electricity powers modern life. As part of our Power sector, you’ll help shape how electricity is generated, transmitted and delivered as global energy demands grow. From massive data centers to modernizing transmission systems, our industry-recognized engineers and scientists have been at the forefront of grid transformation for more than a century. You’ll work side-by-side with these experts and contribute to reliable, resilient and sustainable power systems, helping communities thrive and industries expand. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive infrastructure forward, power innovation and leave your mark on our energy future.

HDR is looking for Professional Engineers for various disciplines and in multiple locations across the country to join our thriving and growing Hydropower Practice. HDR is a hydropower and dam safety industry leader. We are expert FERC Part 12 Dam Safety Program practitioners, and we are at the forefront of performing FERC Comprehensive Assessments (CAs) and Periodic Inspections (PIs). Specifically, HDR seeks Subject Matter Experts in Civil, Hydraulics/Hydrology, Structural, Geotechnical, Geological, and Mechanical engineering.

Our national Hydropower Practice engineering and regulatory team offers core services such as mechanical, electrical, structural, geotechnical and site civil engineering expertise in addition to environmental scientists and regulatory specialists. Hydropower generation is recognized as a critical and renewable component of the US energy portfolio, and our team provides engineering consulting services to all types of hydropower owners located across the U.S. and Canada. If you are looking for a vibrant work environment with career growth opportunities and the chance to work on innovative hydropower, pumped-storage and dam safety projects, we welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Hybrid or flexible work locations are available across the country. Primary duties of the Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert
include:

Support inspections and engineering assessments of existing dams and water retaining structures.
Conduct analyses, evaluations and designs; develop design options or recommendations with supporting calculations.
Preparation of contract documents including drawings, specifications, design documentation and criteria, and cost estimates including critical reports for various new and/or rehabilitation of hydraulic structures, including dams, spillways, gates, outlet works, diversion structures, retaining walls, floodwalls, water conveyance structures, foundations, etc.
Perform engineering assignments that may require critical thinking and creativity to address unique elements that have limited or no specific code based guidance.
Work with multi-disciplinary teams on a variety of hydropower, pumped storage and dam safety engineering projects.
Work independently as project engineer and provide oversight, checking, QA/QC and mentorship of staff as needed or if required.
Participate in risk assessments for dams and hydraulic structures.
Some travel is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Geological, or Geotechnical engineering (or related engineering degree).
Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in one of the following disciplines: Geotechnical, Geological, Civil/Structural or Hydrology and Hydraulics, or Mechanical engineering or life safety and economic consequence estimation.
Experience with dams, water conveyances or other constructed project works and infrastructure associated with hydropower and pumped-storage projects regulated by FERC or other agencies.
Experience working in a multi-discipline environment. 
Proficient with Microsoft Office, Excel and Word, AutoCAD and/or MicroStation experience.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Self-motivated, able to work independently and with a project team to completion of task.
An attitude and commitment to quality, teaming, innovative problem solving, communication, relationship management, and the culture that is integral to our employee ownership model.
Ability to travel as needed for inspections, meetings or other requirements.

Experience specific to the hydropower industry. This could include one or more of the following:
Experience with the FERC dam safety regulatory process including preparation of DSSMPs, DSSMRs, STIDs, and participation in Part 12D dam safety inspections.
FERC dam safety assessment, analysis, and design experience.
Hydropower design experience relative to dams, penstocks, intakes, powerhouses, and/or retaining structures in and around hydropower facilities.
FERC SQRA facilitation training and experience.

,

Bachelor's degree in Engineering
7 years related experience
A minimum 2 years project management experience
Professional Engineer (PE) license
MS Office and MS Project experience is required (Access experience would be plus)
Demonstrated leadership skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement.
